articles.summary: DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PetMed Express, Inc. dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx (NASDAQ: PETS) today announced its financial results for its second quarter ended September 30, 2026. Quarterly Highlights For the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, net sales were $35.8 million compared to $44.4 million for the prior year period, a decrease of 19.4%, primarily driven by a decline in prescription medication sales and higher consumer promotional usage. Net loss for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was $6.4 million, or $(0.31) per diluted share, compared to a net loss of $8.5 million, or $(0.41) per diluted share, for the prior year period. The decrease in net loss was primarily driven by lower general and administrative expenses and advertising expenses. These favorable factors were partially offset by lower gross profit primarily driven by unfavorable product mix shift and lower manufacturer rebates as a percentage of sales, partially offset
articles.title: PetMeds® Announces Second Quarter Financial Results

articles.summary: New Leadership Safeguards Significant Tax Assets to Shield Future Taxable Income and Support Plan to Return PetMeds to Sustainable Profitability and Drive Shareholder Value Concurrently Terminates Prior Limited Duration Shareholder Rights Plan DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx, (Nasdaq: PETS) (the “Company”), today announced that its Board of Directors has approved the adoption of a Tax Benefit Preservation Plan (or “the plan”) which is effective immediately. The plan is specifically tailored to protect and preserve PetMeds’ potentially valuable tax assets primarily associated with net operating loss carryforwards or NOLs that could be utilized in certain circumstances to offset PetMeds’ future taxable income and reduce its future federal income tax liability. articles.summary: DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx (Nasdaq: PETS), today announced a new partnership with Pet Supermarket to offer pet prescription medications, preventatives and health products to pet parents across Pet Supermarket’s retail stores and digital platforms. PetMeds will leverage its pharmacy infrastructure, licensed pharmacists and e-commerce capabilities, including the ability to ship to all 50 states, to provide Pet Supermarket customers with convenient access to trusted medications and health solutions for their animals. Pet Supermarket serves pet parents through approximately 200 retail stores across the Southeast and its e-commerce experience.
